name: PAKFIRE long-history fit 2026-10-26 (937 events 2012-2023)
fitted_on: 937 fire events 2012-2023 (VIIRS footprints plus MODIS MCD64A1); coordinate descent, objective IoU - 0.04*|log2 area ratio| - 0.003*|timing h|

ensemble_widths.method: tools/ensemble_widths.py (50 MODIS-mapped events per split, 16 members): Brier score of the burn probability, 10-90 % area coverage, area PIT
ensemble_widths.chosen: twice the original widths plus a log-normal spread-rate error of 0.9 (best Brier on development events, edge of the grid tested)

terrain_options_test.note: tmoist=1 and chan=1 scored on the 527 held-back events

canopy_crown_test.note: per-cell crown base height and bulk density from Meta/WRI canopy height (canopy=1) vs same code with canopy=0, all 1464 events

note: Fixes the large over-prediction of burned area; shows no shape or direction skill over an equal-area circle. Wind multiplier applies to forecast/archive wind only, never to wind the user sets.

history.step: v1 fuel map (nearest 10 m sample, elevation forest split)
v2 fuel map (10 m class fractions, CGLS forest type), recalibrated
v2 fuel map + objective that also penalises area and timing bias, wider bounds
own mass-conserving terrain wind added (wfield 1.0), roads off
